_about: Public-domain Benjamin Hoadly (1676-1761), Bishop of Bangor and Winchester, of the Bangorian controversy, for the Word Hoard: his Works (London: W. Bowyer and J. Nichols, 1773, three folio volumes), from Internet Archive scans of Eighteenth Century Collections Online. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 44 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

hoadly-works-1: The Works of Benjamin Hoadly, D.D. successively Bishop of Bangor, Hereford, Salisbury, and Winchester, vol. 1 (London, catalogued 1773)
hoadly-works-2: The Works of Benjamin Hoadly, D.D. successively Bishop of Bangor, Hereford, Salisbury, and Winchester, vol. 2 (London, catalogued 1773)
hoadly-works-3: The Works of Benjamin Hoadly, D.D. successively Bishop of Bangor, Hereford, Salisbury, and Winchester, vol. 3 (London, catalogued 1773)

_alternates.hoadly-copies: Separate Sermons (1744, 1749), Sixteen Sermons (1754) and Twenty Sermons (1755), all inside the Works

_excluded.hoadly-other: Sermons on the Mode and Subjects of Baptism (1803), by another Hoadly
